text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock E at a gain did not by itself make those sales wise; I should compare each holding’s future prospects and portfolio role, not just my average cost.","My account value rose over these periods, but that alone does not show which decisions helped; I should review outcomes against my goals and risks rather than crediting or blaming a single trade.","After buying Stock A, I should avoid anchoring on its purchase price and reassess it like every other holding; trade infrequently, but act when a clear portfolio-based reason warrants it."]}
